testsuite.name: org.panchang.api.RoutesTest

testcase.name: nearest in the middle of an ocean says so rather than naming a distant record()
health answers with a version it did not invent()
every refusal is a json document with the same two identifying fields()
a polar site is 422, not 400, and carries wire's own reason verbatim()
a malformed year is 400()
nearest with a latitude off the planet is a malformed request()
nearest names a record and how far away it is, as a label only()
a placeId settles an ambiguous name()
an unknown sampradaya is 404 naming what is known, never another tradition's dates()
no location at all is refused with instructions()
coordinates without a zone are refused rather than guessed()
an unknown time zone is a malformed request, not a polar one()
nearest above the polar limit still answers, and warns before a calendar is asked for()
an ambiguous place is 409 with every candidate named and none chosen()
a place search lists every record carrying the name and chooses none()
an unknown placeId is 404()
meta states what is known, how well, and whose data this is()
a name with no record is 404 and nothing is substituted for it()
a historical name returns no record and the hint that names the modern one()
a malformed date is 400()
coordinates and a place together are refused rather than silently ranked()
a place search without q is refused()
a site below the midnight-sun boundary is answered()
